S.source: printed p. 880; entry 'sun'; sense 2; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'an–sun–in'
S.FORM: mu-riut mashtay k-m-acu sa lhqa ribush a s-in-apuk a lhqa ribush a aqtalha, numa mu-sun i-utu mashtay k-m-an aqtalha, numa ya itia sa p-in-ig-qilha tu caw a qilha an-sun-in i-say yanan lha-lhaushin mi-qilha i-utu, mapa-tig-quyash, matig-qaran i-utu
S.PHON: muriut maʃtaj kmaθu sa ɬqa ribuʃ a sinapuk a ɬqa ribuʃ a aqtaɬa numa musun iutu maʃtaj kman aqtaɬa numa ja itia sa piniŋqiɬa tu θaw a qiɬa ansunin isaj janan ɬaɬauʃin miqiɬa iutu mapatiŋqujaʃ matiŋqaran iutu
S.FORM: mu-riut mashtay k-m-athu sa lhqa ribush a s-in-apuk a lhqa ribush a aqtalha, numa mu-sun i-utu mashtay k-m-an aqtalha, numa ya itia sa p-in-ing-qilha tu thaw a qilha an-sun-in i-say yanan lha-lhaushin mi-qilha i-utu, mapa-ting-quyash, mating-qaran i-utu
S.PHON: muriut maʃtaj kmaθu sa ɬqa ribuʃ a sinapuk a ɬqa ribuʃ a aqtaɬa numa musun iutu maʃtaj kman aqtaɬa numa ja itia sa piniŋqiɬa tu θaw a qiɬa ansunin isaj janan ɬaɬauʃin miqiɬa iutu mapatiŋqujaʃ matiŋqaran iutu
S.TRANSL: Everyone crowded around bringing game, and they gathered to eat the meat, and if someone had home-made wine, they gathered at the swings to drink it, singing and celebrating there

S.source: printed p. 880; entry 'sun'; sense 4; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'kalh–sun–in'
S.FORM: numa sa pazay a kalh-sun-in, sabu-an minabut
S.PHON: numa sa paðaj a kaɬsunin sabuan minabut
S.FORM: numa sa pazay a kalh-sun-in, sabu-an minabut
S.PHON: numa sa paðaj a kaɬsunin sabuan minabut
S.TRANSL: Then the rice would be gathered in heaps (and) covered with rice straw

S.source: printed p. 880; entry 'sun'; sense 7; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'makin–sun'
S.FORM: i-nay a taun c-in-apu-capu makin-sun iza, qauriwa iza
S.PHON: inaj a taun θinapuθapu makinsun iða qauriwa iða
S.FORM: i-nay a taun th-in-apu-thapu makin-sun iza, qauriwa iza
S.PHON: inaj a taun θinapuθapu makinsun iða qauriβa iða
S.TRANSL: The rubbish in this house has been swept into a pile (so) throw it out

S.source: printed p. 880; entry 'sun'; sense 7; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'makin–sun'
S.FORM: ya antu lhiur-in sa tuqic makin-sun numa antu t-un-maza sa lalawa
S.PHON: ja antu ɬiurin sa tuqiθ makinsun numa antu tunmaða sa lalawa
S.FORM: ya antu lhiur-in sa tuqith makin-sun numa antu t-un-maza sa lalawa
S.PHON: ja antu ɬiurin sa tuqiθ makinsun numa antu tunmaða sa lalaβa
S.TRANSL: If you don't remove your ear wax it will collect so that you won't be able to hear people speaking

S.source: printed p. 880; entry 'sun'; sense 8; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'ma–lan–sun'
S.FORM: haya rumfaz ma-nasha marfaz ma-lan-sun tata wa kawi pagqa
S.PHON: haja rumfað manaʃa marfað malansun tata wa kawi paŋqa
S.FORM: haya rumfaz ma-nasha marfaz ma-lan-sun tata wa kawi pangqa
S.PHON: haja rumɸað manaʃa marɸað malansun tata βa kaβi paŋqa
S.TRANSL: That flock of birds all flew down together to settle on one tree

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 8; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'ma–lan–sun ma–lan–sun'
S.FORM: yamin tu kahiwan ya a mu-ribush mun-saháy ma-lan-sun a saran, ya tima sa shau-hala shau-na-say ma-lan-sun a saran patqal-i sa saran
S.PHON: jamin tu kahiwan ja a muribuʃ munsahaj malansun a saran ja tima sa ʃauhala ʃaunasaj malansun a saran patqali sa saran
S.FORM: yamin tu kahiwan ya a mu-ribush mun-sahay ma-lan-sun a saran, ya tima sa shau-hala shau-na-say ma-lan-sun a saran patqal-i sa saran
S.PHON: jamin tu kahiβan ja a muribuʃ munsahaj malansun a saran ja tima sa ʃauhala ʃaunasaj malansun a saran patqali sa saran
S.TRANSL: In the old days when we went hunting (and we) came to a crossroads, whoever arrived there first at the crossroads marked the road

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 9; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'mapa–lan–sun'
S.FORM: yaku a i-say mapa-lan-sun a sazum maniza
S.PHON: jaku a isaj mapalansun a saðum maniða
S.FORM: yaku a i-say mapa-lan-sun a sazum maniza
S.PHON: jaku a isaj mapalansun a saðum maniða
S.TRANSL: I will fish in the place where the rivers flow together

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 10; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'mapa–ia–sun'
S.TRANSL: They are standing side-by-side

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 12; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'mia–sun'
S.FORM: maniun la-tusha mia-sun ya ma-humhum malhus
S.PHON: maniun latuʃa miasun ja mahumhum maɬus
S.FORM: maniun la-tusha mia-sun ya ma-humhum malhus
S.PHON: maniun latuʃa miasun ja mahumhum maɬus
S.TRANSL: Do the two of you sleep in the same place?

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 12; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'mia–sun'

TRANSL.notes: Source note: answer to previous question

S.TRANSL: Yes, we sleep in the same place

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 12; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'mia–sun'
S.FORM: maqa sa caw ya Lus'an ma-qarman ya mia-sun sa binanau'az malhus
S.PHON: maqa sa θaw ja lusʔan maqarman ja miasun sa binanauʔað maɬus
S.FORM: maqa sa thaw ya Lus'an ma-qarman ya mia-sun sa binanau'az malhus
S.PHON: maqa sa θaw ja lusʔan maqarman ja miasun sa binanauʔað maɬus
S.TRANSL: Because for the Thao at New Year's it is bad (for a man) to sleep with his wife

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 12; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'mia–sun'
S.FORM: caycuy la-tusha mia-sun tata wa pagka
S.PHON: θajθuj latuʃa miasun tata wa paŋka
S.FORM: thaythuy la-tusha mia-sun tata wa pangka
S.PHON: θajθuj latuʃa miasun tata βa paŋka
S.TRANSL: The two of them sat on one chair

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 12; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'mia–sun'
S.FORM: haya wa parhaway m-usha binanau'az mia-sun malhus
S.PHON: haja wa parhawaj muʃa binanauʔað miasun maɬus
S.FORM: haya wa parhaway m-usha binanau'az mia-sun malhus
S.PHON: haja βa parhaβaj muʃa binanauʔað miasun maɬus
S.TRANSL: That young man went to look for a woman to sleep with

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 14; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'm–in–ia–sun'; reading 1 of 2 of 'tilha mu–nay a shput kahiwan m–in–ia–sun nam a taun/mapa–ki–bariz'
S.FORM: tilha mu-nay a shput kahiwan m-in-ia-sun nam a taun
S.PHON: tiɬa munaj a ʃput kahiwan miniasun nam a taun
S.FORM: tilha mu-nay a shput kahiwan m-in-ia-sun nam a taun
S.PHON: tiɬa munaj a ʃput kahiβan miniasun nam a taun
S.TRANSL: The person who came yesterday used to get together at our house

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 14; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'm–in–ia–sun'; reading 2 of 2 of 'tilha mu–nay a shput kahiwan m–in–ia–sun nam a taun/mapa–ki–bariz'
S.FORM: tilha mu-nay a shput kahiwan m-in-ia-sun nam a mapa-ki-bariz
S.PHON: tiɬa munaj a ʃput kahiwan miniasun nam a mapakibarið
S.FORM: tilha mu-nay a shput kahiwan m-in-ia-sun nam a mapa-ki-bariz
S.PHON: tiɬa munaj a ʃput kahiβan miniasun nam a mapakibarið
S.TRANSL: The person who came yesterday used to get together at our house

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 15; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'mun–su–sun'
S.TRANSL: They all came together to build (houses)

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 15; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'mun–su–sun'
S.FORM: kahiwan sa caw ya mu-buhat mun-su-sun, numa ya m-apa sa pazay makinwail ma-qa-quyash
S.PHON: kahiwan sa θaw ja mubuhat munsusun numa ja mapa sa paðaj makinwail maqaqujaʃ
S.FORM: kahiwan sa thaw ya mu-buhat mun-su-sun, numa ya m-apa sa pazay makinwail ma-qa-quyash
S.PHON: kahiβan sa θaw ja mubuhat munsusun numa ja mapa sa paðaj makinβail maqaqujaʃ
S.TRANSL: When the old-time Thao worked in the fields they came together and carried the (harvested) rice on their backs chanting and singing

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 16; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'mu–sun'
S.TRANSL: The two of them came to sit together

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 16; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'mu–sun'
S.FORM: q-un-riu', numa painan numa sh-ug-kash mu-sun
S.PHON: qunriuʔ numa painan numa ʃuŋkaʃ musun
S.FORM: q-un-riu', numa painan numa sh-ung-kash mu-sun
S.PHON: qunriuʔ numa painan numa ʃuŋkaʃ musun
S.TRANSL: (He) stole (something) so maybe he is afraid to join us

S.source: printed p. 881; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 18; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'pakin–sun'
S.FORM: pasay-in lagqisusay a tahamish pu-i-utu-n sa rabu pakin-sun, numa sa tahamish a ruzic sabu-an pia-tiric-in s-m-abu uka sa rabu mu-qca min-dadu sa apuy
S.PHON: pasajin laŋqisusaj a tahamiʃ puiutun sa rabu pakinsun numa sa tahamiʃ a ruðiθ sabuan piatiriθin smabu uka sa rabu muqθa mindadu sa apuj
S.FORM: pasay-in langqisusay a tahamish pu-i-utu-n sa rabu pakin-sun, numa sa tahamish a ruzith sabu-an pia-tirith-in s-m-abu uka sa rabu mu-qtha min-dadu sa apuy
S.PHON: pasajin laŋqisusaj a tahamiʃ puiutun sa rabu pakinsun numa sa tahamiʃ a ruðiθ sabuan piatiriθin smabu uka sa rabu muqθa mindadu sa apuj
S.TRANSL: Use a small jar to gather the coals, and then cover the mouth of the container tightly so that they won't burst into flame again

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 19; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'pia–lan–sun pia–lan–sun'
S.FORM: pia-lan-sun man un a m-usha ribush t-m-uqris; mu-kaktun iza pia-lan-sun mu-shuqish
S.PHON: pialansun man un a muʃa ribuʃ tmuqris mukaktun iða pialansun muʃuqiʃ
S.FORM: pia-lan-sun man un a m-usha ribush t-m-uqris; mu-kaktun iza pia-lan-sun mu-shuqish
S.PHON: pialansun man un a muʃa ribuʃ tmuqris mukaktun iða pialansun muʃuqiʃ
S.TRANSL: Go to the forest together to set your traps (and) when you are done come back together

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 20; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'pia–sun'
S.FORM: m-ihu a aniamin masa nak a aniamin pia-sun
S.PHON: mihu a aniamin masa nak a aniamin piasun
S.FORM: m-ihu a aniamin masa nak a aniamin pia-sun
S.PHON: mihu a aniamin masa nak a aniamin piasun
S.TRANSL: Your things and mine have been put together

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 21; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'pia–sun–i'
S.TRANSL: Don't gather the rice here, put it separately

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 22; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'pia–sun–in'
S.FORM: nak a a'a kahiwan malhus pia-sun-in cicu a ama pa-kalhus, masa ina wa cicu
S.PHON: nak a aʔa kahiwan maɬus piasunin θiθu a ama pakaɬus masa ina wa θiθu
S.FORM: nak a a'a kahiwan malhus pia-sun-in thithu a ama pa-kalhus, masa ina wa thithu
S.PHON: nak a aʔa kahiβan maɬus piasunin θiθu a ama pakaɬus masa ina βa θiθu
S.TRANSL: My baby long ago used to sleep together with his father and mother

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 23; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'p–in–u–sun'
S.FORM: maqa tu kahiwan tu ina-ama p-in-u-sun antu mia-zay cuini min-an-anak k-m-ilhim sa a min-ayuzi ya a mim-binanau'az
S.PHON: maqa tu kahiwan tu inaama pinusun antu miaðaj θuini minananak kmiɬim sa a minajuði ja a mimbinanauʔað
S.FORM: maqa tu kahiwan tu ina-ama p-in-u-sun antu mia-zay thuini min-an-anak k-m-ilhim sa a min-ayuzi ya a mim-binanau'az
S.PHON: maqa tu kahiβan tu inaama pinusun antu miaðaj θuini minananak kmiɬim sa a minajuði ja a mimbinanauʔað
S.TRANSL: Because in the old days (one's) parents brought them together (in an arranged marriage), not like today when one can choose one's husband or wife oneself

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 24; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'pu–sun'
S.TRANSL: The beads are strung together

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 25; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'pu–sun–ik'; reading 1 of 2 of 'haya (wa) patash–an pu–sun–ik'
S.TRANSL: I gathered the books together

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 25; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'pu–sun–ik'; reading 2 of 2 of 'haya (wa) patash–an pu–sun–ik'
S.TRANSL: I gathered the books together

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 26; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'pu–sun–in'; reading 1 of 2 of 'haya (wa) patash–an pu–sun–in cicu'
S.TRANSL: He gathered the books together

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 26; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'pu–sun–in'; reading 2 of 2 of 'haya (wa) patash–an pu–sun–in cicu'
S.TRANSL: He gathered the books together

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 26; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'pu–sun–in'
S.FORM: numa sa i-zay dadú pu-sun-in cicu sa caw
S.PHON: numa sa iðaj dadu pusunin θiθu sa θaw
S.FORM: numa sa i-zay dadu pu-sun-in thithu sa thaw
S.PHON: numa sa iðaj dadu pusunin θiθu sa θaw

TRANSL.notes: Literal translation: Then that chief, the people were gathered by him

S.TRANSL: Then the chief gathered the people together

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 28; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'sun–an'
S.FORM: haya caw ma-cuaw ma-qarman ya sun-an
S.PHON: haja θaw maθuaw maqarman ja sunan
S.FORM: haya thaw ma-thuaw ma-qarman ya sun-an
S.PHON: haja θaw maθuaw maqarman ja sunan

TRANSL.notes: Literal translation: That person is bad to associate with

S.TRANSL: That person is hard to get along with

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 28; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'sun–an'
S.FORM: haya wa shput ma-qarman ya sun-an, miarain p-aca-p-acay sa suma, ma-ashkaz
S.PHON: haja wa ʃput maqarman ja sunan miarain paθapaθaj sa suma maaʃkað
S.FORM: haya wa shput ma-qarman ya sun-an, miarain p-atha-p-athay sa suma, ma-ashkaz
S.PHON: haja βa ʃput maqarman ja sunan miarain paθapaθaj sa suma maaʃkað
S.TRANSL: That person is bad to associate with, he often fights with others (and) is scheming

S.source: printed p. 882; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 29; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'shan–sun'
S.FORM: i-nay a ruku qusaz-in talha-punal-in, numa shan-sun sa rashrash
S.PHON: inaj a ruku qusaðin taɬapunalin numa ʃansun sa raʃraʃ
S.FORM: i-nay a ruku qusaz-in talha-punal-in, numa shan-sun sa rashrash
S.PHON: inaj a ruku qusaðin taɬapunalin numa ʃansun sa raʃraʃ
S.TRANSL: (Because) of the rains detritus was washed into this valley bottom so that gravel has collected here

S.source: printed p. 883; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 30; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'tan–sun–i'
S.TRANSL: Pile up the stones

S.source: printed p. 883; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 31; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'tan–sun–in'
S.TRANSL: He put the sweet potatoes into a pile

S.source: printed p. 883; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 32; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 't–in–an–sun'
S.TRANSL: Father piled up the wood

S.source: printed p. 883; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 34; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'u–sun'
S.FORM: u-sun maniun malhus a maqa a ma-shimzaw
S.PHON: usun maniun maɬus a maqa a maʃimðaw
S.FORM: u-sun maniun malhus a maqa a ma-shimzaw
S.PHON: usun maniun maɬus a maqa a maʃimðaw
S.TRANSL: Gather together to sleep because it is going to be cold

S.source: printed p. 883; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 35; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'u–sun–in'
S.FORM: m-ihu a qilha, haya wa qilha u-sun-in, caycuy q-un-riu' m-ara
S.PHON: mihu a qiɬa haja wa qiɬa usunin θajθuj qunriuʔ mara
S.FORM: m-ihu a qilha, haya wa qilha u-sun-in, thaythuy q-un-riu' m-ara
S.PHON: mihu a qiɬa haja βa qiɬa usunin θajθuj qunriuʔ mara
S.TRANSL: Your wine was put together with that wine (and) they stole it

S.source: printed p. 883; entry 'sun' (opens on p. 880); sense 35; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'u–sun–in'
S.TRANSL: Let's gather to eat

S.source: printed p. 883; entry 'sunda'; illustrates 'sunda'
S.TRANSL: real aboriginal wine

S.source: printed p. 883; entry 'sunda'; illustrates 'sunda'
S.TRANSL: That chief is truly the most important

S.source: printed p. 883; entry 'sunda'; illustrates 'sunda'
S.TRANSL: water that is not really hot

S.source: printed p. 883; entry 'sunda'; illustrates 'sunda'
S.TRANSL: He really looks like a Thao

S.source: printed p. 883; entry 'sunda'; sense 2; illustrates 'pin–sunda qilha'
S.FORM: yamin caw ya a pin-sunda qilha sa tahamish ia-naur-an pasay-in lindash sh-m-inaw a maqa sa qilha a ma-qmin ma-kanshuz
S.PHON: jamin θaw ja a pinsunda qiɬa sa tahamiʃ ianauran pasajin lindaʃ ʃminaw a maqa sa qiɬa a maqmin makanʃuð
S.FORM: yamin thaw ya a pin-sunda qilha sa tahamish ia-naur-an pasay-in lindash sh-m-inaw a maqa sa qilha a ma-qmin ma-kanshuz
S.PHON: jamin θaw ja a pinsunda qiɬa sa tahamiʃ ianauran pasajin lindaʃ ʃminaw a maqa sa qiɬa a maqmin makanʃuð
S.TRANSL: When we Thao make native wine we usually use lindash to clean the wine jar so that the wine will be strong and fragrant

S.source: printed p. 883; entry 'sunut'; sense 2; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'ma–sunut'
S.FORM: yaku ya ma-humhum iza ya malhus iza a ma-sunut uan apuy a maqa a yanan rabu a shashanu a pit'ia iza, mu-hiaw min-dadu sa apuy
S.PHON: jaku ja mahumhum iða ja maɬus iða a masunut uan apuj a maqa a janan rabu a ʃaʃanu a pitʔia iða muhiaw mindadu sa apuj
S.FORM: yaku ya ma-humhum iza ya malhus iza a ma-sunut uan apuy a maqa a yanan rabu a shashanu a pit'ia iza, mu-hiaw min-dadu sa apuy
S.PHON: jaku ja mahumhum iða ja maɬus iða a masunut uan apuj a maqa a janan rabu a ʃaʃanu a pitʔia iða muhiaw mindadu sa apuj
S.TRANSL: At night when I go to sleep I will smother the fire so we will have embers in the morning to cook, to quickly start a fire

S.source: printed p. 884; entry 'sunut' (opens on p. 883); sense 3; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 's–in–unut'
S.TRANSL: Someone has put out the fire

S.source: printed p. 884; entry 'sunut' (opens on p. 883); sense 4; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 's–m–unut'
S.TRANSL: I smothered/ am smothering the fire

S.source: printed p. 884; entry 'sunut' (opens on p. 883); sense 5; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'sunut–in'
S.TRANSL: I smothered/ am smothering the fire

S.source: printed p. 884; entry 'suqum'; sense 2; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 's–in–uqum–an'
